profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Clear Street

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Apache Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring · PostgreSQL · Java

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a software engineer at Chainalysis, I have the opportunity to work across multiple product teams, including Compliance (KYT, Kryptos), Data (data pipelines for ingesting and transforming various blockchain data), and Investigations (Reactor, public APIs).

The engineering culture is one of "you build it, you own it", meaning writing the code, CI/CD, setting up the infrastructure, monitoring and observability, being on-call and documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Spring · Java

positions.title: Senior Technical Lead
positions.description:
As a Senior Tech Lead, my responsibilities include:
- leading an offshore development team
- interfacing with Product and Design to gather requirements
- build micro-services using Docker, Spring Boot and terraform in AWS
- using AWS EMR / Spark and data pipelines, handle ETL workloads for both internal and client-facing reports

positions.title: Java Architect
positions.description: As an architect at Tinypass, Kyung is required to develop and design features rapidly at this up and coming e-commerce startup. As with any startup, Kyung has to wear multiple hats, often at the same time. At any given moment, Kyung can be writing code in IntelliJ, looking through apache/tomcat log files to debug a problem, answering customer support inquiries, configuring Wordpress and hacking at PHP, or writing scripts to automate or make his life easier in bash or Ruby.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: Design, architect, and develop technical solutions for clients. Typical projects include backend system integration with various client properties, interfacing with external 3rd party services, and content management and eCommerce solutions. Clients include Bloomberg Wealth, Bloomberg Sports, US Air Force, The Northern Trust, Discovery Channel, Citi.

positions.title: Director, Java Platforms
positions.description: Primary focus on business development for backend technology work and oversee/manage Java team. Responsibilities included responding to RFPs, staff hiring/augmentation (Java specifically), overseeing all Java projects, company-wide

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: Handle all things technology for e-learning startup. This includes purchasing computers/servers/hardware, setting up network/VPNs, handling telephony, setting up wiring for offices, development and management of company software, and hiring.
